SELECT t.id, s.k, x, y FROM (VALUES (1, 'a', 1), (2, 'a', 2), (3, 'b', 3)) t(id, g, n)
    JOIN (VALUES (1, 'u'), (1, 'v'), (2, 'u'), (3, 'u'), (3, 'v')) s(id, k) ON t.id = s.id DECIDE x(REAL), y(REAL) SUCH THAT x <= 9 AND y <= 9 AND sum(t: t.n * x) + max(s.id * y) <= 10 MAXIMIZE sum(x) + sum(y)
